en.t: The sky slowly began to brighten.

units.source_text: 有一回，他站在某街的拐角眺望广阔的市场。

en.t: Once, he stood at the corner of a certain street and gazed out over the broad marketplace.

units.source_text: 市场上络绎不绝的人和车子都浸染成了玫瑰色。

en.t: The endless stream of people and carts in the market was all suffused with a rose color.
